issues.detail: The Hebrew 'כְפֹרַחַת' means 'budding/blossoming', not '展開時像雛鳥' (when it spreads out like a fledgling bird). The Chinese adds an image of a bird ('雛鳥') that is not in the Hebrew, and '展開' (spread out) misrepresents the verb 'עָלְתָה' (it went up/ascended) and the participle 'כְפֹרַחַת' (budding). This changes the meaning of the verse.
